svg.title: Figure 3-1. System element hierarchy of LD-SDA (WP-S-03 §3.1, §5, §6, §8)
svg.desc: The LD-SDA system, the system node of WP-C-01 Figure 3-1, consists of seven architecture elements (WP-S-03 §3.1). The QM partition holds E-01 SoC software (QM, highest TSR ASIL QM (B-sup)), E-02 ML models (QM, SOTIF/PAS 8800) and E-04b the rest of the device hardware (QM). The ASIL C safety envelope holds E-03a safety layer, E-03b panda platform firmware and E-04a safety MCU hardware (all ASIL C, DQ-341); E-03a and E-03b refine E-03, E-04a and E-04b refine E-04 of WP-C-01. E-05 harness is B for PCS restore and C for blocking. Each element carries its TSRs from §5 and the safety mechanisms of §6 assigned to it alone; twelve mechanisms are shared by two elements and listed separately. E-01 consists of the openpilot processes of §8: nine safety-related processes, seven QM input processes, two HMI processes, hardwared, twelve logging and support processes, five remote-access and update processes, and four debug processes that must be absent. E-02 consists of the driving model and the DM model; E-04b of SoC, cameras, IMU, display, speaker, power supply and enclosure; E-03a of the opendbc safety core and the Toyota mode; E-03b of main loop, tick handler, CAN/SPI drivers, comms handlers, harness/relay driver, fault handling and bootstub; E-04a of clock, supply, memories, SPI4, FDCAN1–3, ADC, GPIO and the DAC/codec siren path; E-05 of intercept relay, ignition line and orientation sense. EXT-EPS, EXT-PCM and EXT-CLU are outside the item, AoU only, with TSR-111, 208, 310 and 708; the system commands them through IF-01 and reads them through IF-02. OPS TSR-801 to 818 are not allocated to an element.
svg.text: LD-SDA system → architecture elements (§3.1) → hardware parts and software units (§3.1, §8), after ISO 26262-1:2018 3.39 · TSRs of §5 and SMs of §6 per element
level above: item node of WP-C-01 Figure 3-1
= the system node of WP-C-01 Figure 3-1 · reference configuration (§1)
Up to ASIL C (SG-02, SG-03, SG-06); safety envelope hardened to ASIL C (DQ-341) · ASIL notation C, B, B‡, QM (B-sup) per WP-S-02 §2.1
AP-1: all actuation passes through the safety envelope E-03, which enforces the safety goals regardless of the QM SoC
TSRs not allocated to an element: OPS 801–818 (§5) · E-03a/E-03b TSRs refine to SWSR (WP-W-02), E-04a/E-05 TSRs to HWSR (WP-H-01)

SM-01…SM-45: 33 on one element (in the boxes) + 12 shared (here).

Numbers are TSR-xxx of WP-S-02 as §5 lists them (ranges as given); notes on processes are the §8 role and TSRs. Static decomposition as inherited at 8b8c6ae; no implementation or verification status is shown.
